title: W0 Validator Runtime Prelaunch Assertion
description: Operator-external assertion consumed before VALIDATE starts Python. Signed bytes are the exact raw generated assertion file in required-list order, minified UTF-8, no BOM/newline/duplicate keys/extra whitespace. Paths come only from out-of-band inputs. Authority binds config/package, complete project/source+temp inputs, external authorization evidence root, identities, runtime/source closure, and an enforcement window that remains continuous through postexecution, human authorization, expected-only admission, ADMIT semantic PASS, signed execution/worker-ready receipt verification, bootstrap PASS, and first-effect capability consumption. A local/project-created, expired, reserialized, redirected, partial-read-set, lock-gap, stale/replayed-capability, or unverifiable object is STOP/HUMAN.

launchChallengeSha256.description: Hash of the byte-identical schema-valid PREPARE output supplied separately to LAUNCH.

challengeFileIdentity.description: Authority-observed identity of the external proof-sealing challenge file. The challenge is intentionally outside its self-referential read/temp digests but is locked separately by path/hash/identity.

operatorExpectedConfigSha256.description: Signed copy of the independently supplied CLI expected hash; exact-matches challenge/PREPARE/actual config/post/admission.

configSha256.description: Recomputed raw config hash, equal to operatorExpectedConfigSha256.

projectRootIdentity.description: Authority-observed immutable volume/file identity of the resolved project root.

projectInputTreeSha256.description: Receiver-rederived all-regular-project-files-canonical-json-v1 digest: every regular file recursively below resolvedProjectRoot, no exclusions, Unicode-ordinal sorted by normalized unique relative POSIX path, closed {path,bytes,sha256}, UTF-8 json.dumps({files:[...]}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). Reparse/symlink/mount/special/escape fails.

tempCopySetSha256.description: PREPARE-derived complete temp tree digest; exact validator entrypoint plus three support files, no extras.

readInputSetSha256.description: PREPARE-derived sorted-read-input-records-canonical-json-v1 digest over unique closed {normalizedAbsolutePath as path,bytes,sha256}. It exact-covers config, package, full installed Skill closure, runtime manifests/anchors, every traversed baseline snapshot/evidence/config, and the prepared temp validator/support files.

readInputIdentitySetSha256.description: Authority-only canonical digest over the same ordinal-sorted paths as closed {path,volumeIdentity,fileIdentity}. Receiver does not invent Windows file IDs; it verifies the signature and exact pre/post equality.

$comment: Before Python, receiver verifies the detached signature over PREPARE and exact-matches runId, nonce, sessions, config/package/project/Skill/host/bootstrap facts, challenge and authorization-evidence-root identities, temp root, chronology, write policy, and exit 0. The evidence root is the sole post-VALIDATE write exception; it may contain only the exact human chain/authorization/admission set and never project/package bytes.

absolutePath.description: Windows local-drive absolute path for W0 lifecycle v1. POSIX, UNC, device, ADS, and relative paths are invalid.
